title: The Phantom Regiment
logline: An old military communication buoy suddenly starts broadcasting reinforcement codes for a regiment that was wiped out decades ago.

roles.description: Polite, deeply paranoid, haunted by their past.
Intense, heavily scarred, refuses to believe their regiment is gone.
A rusted, automated comms buoy drifting in the dark.
A ruthless private military company hired to clean up loose ends.
A heavily armed warship looking for the beacon.

public_situation: An old regiment beacon has started broadcasting reinforcement codes for a unit that was wiped out decades ago, and nobody will say who switched it on.
private_truth: The negotiator sold out the regiment's position decades ago. The beacon's activation means someone knows the truth and is hunting them.

beats.public_change: The mercenary fleet cordons off the sector around the beacon.

missions.reason: The negotiator hires the pilot to fly out to the beacon to see who activated it.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the beacon was triggered manually by someone inside the dark zone.

missions.reason: The soldier pays the pilot to collect a physical data drop left near the beacon.
missions.private_fact: The data drop contains old regiment ciphers proving someone survived the massacre.

beats.public_change: The loyalist soldier publicly claims they have found survivors of the old regiment.

missions.reason: The soldier hires the pilot to deliver a supply cache to the beacon's coordinates.
missions.private_fact: There are no survivors. The soldier is using the supplies as bait to draw out the mercenaries.

beats.public_change: The mercenary fleet begins sweeping the dark zone with active sensors.

missions.reason: The negotiator panics and hires the pilot to destroy a mercenary scout before it finds the beacon's logs.
missions.private_fact: The scout has already downloaded partial logs implicating the negotiator.

beats.public_change: The main mercenary cruiser intercepts the soldier and prepares to execute them.

missions.reason: The negotiator pays the pilot to destroy the cruiser and ensure the soldier dies in the crossfire.
missions.private_fact: The soldier hails the pilot from the cruiser's brig, offering evidence of the negotiator's treason if the pilot saves them.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the cruiser, killing the soldier.
resolutions.summary: The negotiator's secret is safe. The phantom regiment is officially declared dead, and the pilot is paid in untraceable credits.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the soldier's offer and saves them.
resolutions.summary: The negotiator is exposed as a traitor and lynched by veterans. The soldier finally finds peace.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the lost regiment didn't die by accident.

resolutions.summary: The mercenaries execute the soldier and secure the beacon. The truth is lost.

loose_threads.detail: The mercenary fleet is being paid directly by the naval intelligence discretionary fund.
The supposedly abandoned beacon had its power cells replaced only six months ago by a civilian freighter.

radio_hooks: A dead regiment's beacon wakes up, and old families start asking questions.
{role:mercenary_fleet} claims jurisdiction over dark zone beacon.

voice_direction.guilty_negotiator: Smooth, but their voice cracks when they are stressed.
voice_direction.loyalist_soldier: Gravelly, humorless, speaks like they are issuing orders.
